setup.text: The Festival Grounds glow as the rite-fire burns bright, casting shadows across lanterns lined along the Arch. The priest dips a taper into the flames and sends the fire across in one motion.

option_a.text: The player asks, "Does the flame run out?" The priest glances up from the lantern, his lined face softening. "Depends how far it's asked to go. One flame, one send."

option_b.text: The player dips a second taper into the fire and sends it to the next lantern along the row. The wick catches the flame instantly and holds steady.

option_c.text: The flame touches the water and dies instantly, leaving only a wisp of smoke.
